messages:
Liam (People Ops): Idea: pilot a tiny vending-style kiosk that dispenses sticker packs + single-use coffee coupons when teammates redeem spot awards. Low-friction recognition moment in SF lobby for two weeks in July. Who can help scope? :coffee::sparkles:
Cara (Office Ops): Space ok in Lobby C by reception. Need one outlet and a small table. I can handle pickup and daily checks.
Evan (Finance): Rough estimate: unit rental $600, initial stock $180, printing tokens $40, misc $80. Total ~$900. We should set a per-site redemption cap to control spend.
Liam (People Ops): Proposal: cap $500/site for pilot, vouchers limited to one per person per day, token expiry 72h. Remote folks get digital sticker pack + e-coupon.
Marta (Legal): Keep it simple: one-per-person clause and opt-in language for shipping addresses. If collecting names, include retention period. I can draft a short consent blurb.
kudos-bot: Note: previous pilot docs: https://drive.internal/culture/past_pilots.pdf
Ivy (Events): Vendor idea: MiniVend Co. supports QR redemption and custom slot labels; lead time 2 weeks. They can print token cards on-site.
Cara (Office Ops): Allergy labels yes. Recommend 3 vegan-friendly slots and 3 snack slots. Also need a small lockbox for unused physical tokens.
Evan (Finance): Approve concept pending PO and vendor quote. Please include line-item pricing on the quote. We'll code expenses to CULT-PILOT-2026.
Liam (People Ops): Action items: Ivy to get 2 vendor quotes by Thursday; Marta to draft consent blurb; Cara to confirm outlet/space; Evan to set provisional budget cap. If no blockers, we'll book for July 13-24. Thanks team!
